verdict.rationale: The Wyoming Secretary of State is a government business-registry and filing portal. The evidence covers annual reports, entity search, registered-agent changes, and similar filings, with no user-built automations of any kind. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product, not an unevidenced capability. The probes found no API, llms.txt, or OpenAPI spec, which also gives no sign the product ships any automation layer.
